d:
A new Vote Vibe survey has revealed interesting figures ahead of the 2027 UP Assembly elections. While the BJP alliance leads in voting preference, the Samajwadi Party alliance is ahead in respondents' perception of which party will win. The survey also compares Yogi Adityanath and Akhilesh Yadav as chief ministerial choices.
